title: Rodent microdialysis studies show DMT levels spike at death

plain: Laboratory studies are said to have measured DMT, a powerful psychedelic chemical the body makes on its own, in the brains of living rats, and found that the levels rise sharply as the animal dies. The neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore describes these experiments without naming the study. If it holds, the brain may flood itself with a psychedelic at the moment of death.
